svg.text: Swipe anatomy
One drag in eight stages, drawn after the Gmail swipe: a detached card and a separate pill. 35 percent is the Normal arming point.
Idle
The row is a card in the list. Nothing sits
behind it. A drag begins after 8 dp of
horizontal movement within 30 degrees
of horizontal.
Dragging
The card follows the finger. A separate
pill in the action colour fills the space it
leaves: row height, 4 dp from the card, 8
dp from the row edge, icon centred.
Armed
Past 35 percent the pill goes to full
colour, the icon scales to 1.2 and the arm
haptic fires. Dragging back disarms with
a lighter haptic.
Committing
Release while armed, or a fling past 20
percent. The card slides off with the fast
spatial spring while the pill widens to the
full row width.
Collapsing
Pill and slot collapse together and the
rows below close up. Snackbar with
Undo for 5 s. The operation is only
queued.
Mark read: dragging
Rows that stay in place: right swipe, blue
pill, same geometry, threshold and
haptic.
Mark read: armed
The icon shows what the swipe will do:
open envelope marks read, closed
envelope with a dot marks unread.
Mark read: settled
The card springs back to place and the
pill shrinks into the edge. Dot and bold
cross-fade. No snackbar, no collapse.
Croft wireframes · green = primary action · wax red = destructive · amber = star and snooze · blue = read state · wax tags = behaviour notes
